subject: FinPay - MAP and stakeholder map / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finpay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: FinPay - MAP and stakeholder map / next steps

Tom — thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) attached for your review. Key takeaways: 

- Business need: reduce inference cost and latency for payment fraud scoring model while keeping parity with current accuracy.
- Decision criteria: latency (p99 < 120ms), cost per 1M tokens, SOC2 + encryption at rest, ability to run in VPC/Private deployment.
- Primary technical eval: run 2-week pilot on dedicated pool with a representative model and 50M monthly tokens.
- Timeline: target procurement decision by end of Q2; pilot to start mid-March if procurement clears.

Stakeholder map (as I captured it):
- Economic buyer: Tom Reynolds (Head of Product) — budget approval and timeline owner
- Security/legal owner: Sarah Li (Security Lead) — will handle the security questionnaire and SSO/KMS questions
- Procurement: Aisha Khan (Procurement) — will lead terms, PO and contracts
- Technical champion: Michael (ML Eng) — will run pilot and provide evaluation results

Next steps I propose (and added to the attached MAP):
1) Marissa: share MAP v1 and Redwood pilot plan (attached) — today
2) FinPay: confirm stakeholders & timeline, share procurement contact if different — by Tue 3/2
3) Redwood/FinPay: schedule kickoff to scope pilot (30-60 min) — week of 3/9
4) FinPay: return completed security questionnaire — by 3/12

Attachment: [attachment: FinPay-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

If anything above is off, flag it and I’ll update the MAP. Happy to jump on a quick sync to walk through.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@finpay.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@finpay.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinPay - MAP and stakeholder map / next steps

Marissa — appreciate the clear recap and the MAP. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Stakeholders: your mapping is correct. Two notes: procurement (Aisha) wants to see a ballpark TCO and any standard contract terms up front. Sarah (security) will want to validate data residency and key management; she prefers to get the security questionnaire before the kickoff.

2) Timeline: procurement has an internal cadence that means we need budget approved by 5/28 to make the end-of-Q2 delivery. So that lines up with your proposed dates but would prefer kickoff earlier if we can (first week of March).

3) Pilot scope: ML Eng (Michael) will confirm the exact model and representative dataset, but we can assume a 2-week pilot with 2M tokens/day average. Could you share a short pilot runbook and what success metrics Redwood will collect?

4) Pricing: before the kickoff, Aisha asked for a pricing band (not final) to include in the internal budget ask. Can you provide a rough estimate for the pilot (and a per-token range for production) so I can set expectations?

I attached FinPay's standard security checklist to speed Sarah up. 

Thanks — Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Product, FinPay
Tom.Reynolds@finpay.com

Attachment: [attachment: FinPay-Security-Questionnaire.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finpay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@finpay.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@finpay.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinPay - MAP and stakeholder map / next steps

Tom — great, thanks for the quick reply and the security questionnaire. I updated the MAP to reflect procurement's ask and moved the kickoff target to the week of 3/2 to accommodate an earlier start. See updated action items in the attached MAP.

Quick answers inline: 
- Pilot runbook: attached one-pager (see MAP appendix) — includes onboarding steps, expected datasets, and success metrics (latency p50/p95/p99, throughput, model quality AUC lift, and cost per 1M tokens).
- Metrics we’ll collect: p50/p95/p99 latency, per-token cost, model quality (AUC/accuracy delta vs baseline), error rate, and resource utilization. We’ll provide a short dashboard link after kickoff.
- Pricing ballpark: for a 2-week pilot on a dedicated small pool, expect ~$9k-12k total depending on runtime and model size. Production per-token range depends a lot on batching/quantization but ballpark $X.00-$Y.00 per 1k tokens - we can provide a model-specific estimate after Michael confirms model size. (Note: I left placeholders so we can confirm exact numbers post-scope.)

Dev (cc'd) — I’m going to loop you into the kickoff planning and ask if we can provision a small dedicated pool for the pilot starting 3/2. Lauren — can you help with the internal SSO/KMS checklist item for Sarah?

Next steps:
- Marissa: send updated MAP + pilot runbook (attached) — done
- FinPay: return completed security questionnaire (Sarah) — target 3/5
- FinPay: procurement to indicate required PO/contract steps (Aisha) — target 3/5
- Redwood: confirm pilot capacity and share pricing range (Dev) — target 2/28

Attachment: [attachment: FinPay-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@finpay.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@finpay.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinPay - MAP and stakeholder map / next steps

Marissa — this looks good. Confirming: kickoff for scoping pilot on Tue 3/3 at 10am PT works for our team. Sarah will aim to return the security questionnaire by 3/5. Aisha says procurement will need the ballpark pricing by EOD 2/28 for the internal budget ask (I'll forward your pricing note to her).

One ask: can Redwood include a short line in the MAP about fallback plans (e.g., we need an automatic fallback to the hosted model if latency or errors exceed thresholds during pilot)? That will help procurement and ops feel comfortable.

I'll see you all on 3/3 - sending calendar invite now.

Tom
